threshold_note: Numeric thresholds are tunable coach heuristics, not sourced game rules. Camp availability and enemy cooldowns are not inferred from absence.

cards.speech: {lane} is pushed out. Check the next lane before you take a camp.
cards.rationale: Recognize a useful wave state without claiming a kill or a safe route.

sources.excerpt: pushing the wave creates safe space for you

cards.speech: {target} is low in {target_lane} and a teammate is there. Go for the gank, then come back for your wave.
cards.rationale: A rotation needs both wave priority and a specific vulnerable, located target with nearby support.

sources.excerpt: wave crashed into enemy guardian; enemy laner died/recalled; neighbor lane winnable

cards.speech: Last-hit and deny. Don't trade away your wave.
cards.rationale: Lane income takes priority over low-value harassment.

sources.excerpt: safe last hits and denies over risky harass

cards.speech: {lane} is coming to us. Catch it from cover before you take camps.
cards.rationale: Protect lane income before spending time on a neutral camp.

sources.excerpt: Clearing a Trooper wave is generally faster and pays more than a camp, so camp between waves

cards.speech: Hold your side: they have more heroes here. Keep your last hits.
cards.rationale: A visible local numbers disadvantage favors a defensive wave position.

sources.excerpt: 1v2: stop pushing, hold wave near own side, give up denies, don't die

cards.speech: Back behind cover: you're getting low. Trade again when healed.
cards.rationale: Preserve health and lane uptime instead of taking another low-value trade. Said in rotation (rec8 spoke the same sentence six times, rec13 nine): the variants, and the situation when it is read (afflicted, in their half).
variants: You're at {pct}%: step back behind cover and heal.
Low health: back off behind our wave, then trade again.
Step out of their range: you're at {pct}%.

situations.afflicted: Afflicted at {pct}%: get out of {hero}'s range now.
situations.forward: You're in their half at {pct}%: walk back to {front}.

sources.excerpt: Don't trade unless it wins you a last hit or a kill. Back off and farm.

cards.speech: Health critical: get out now. Break line of sight and heal.
cards.rationale: Below about 15% health any trooper volley or ability finishes you; the call overrides every other plan and needs only one bar-checked reading. "Health critical" is said only under 30% health (rec13 37:53 said it at 48%); a fast fall above that gets the fast wording, and the phrasings rotate.
variants: Get out now: you're at {pct}%. Break line of sight.
Out now, one more hit kills you. Find cover.
You're nearly dead: break line of sight and run.
fast: Dropping fast at {pct}%: get out now.
You're losing health fast: back out now.
Big damage on you: leave the fight now.

sources.excerpt: Troopers deal deceptively high damage if you overextend

cards.speech: You're ahead of your trooper wave. Step back behind it.
cards.rationale: Do not expose yourself ahead of wave cover while an enemy marker is nearby.

sources.excerpt: Troopers deal deceptively high damage if you overextend

cards.speech: Clear the {lane} wave first. Crash it, and stay behind our troopers.
cards.rationale: Wave priority creates the window to rotate without sacrificing lane income.

sources.excerpt: crash (shove) before leaving lane so you don't pay a
Pressure the guardian only with a crashed wave tanking

cards.speech: Our wave has the numbers. Poke from cover between last hits.
cards.rationale: Use wave cover for a short trade without giving up farm or assuming enemy cooldowns.

sources.excerpt: peeking from the right side of cover exposes less than left
safe last hits and denies over risky harass

cards.speech: {lane} is pushed. Take one nearby camp if it is up, then back to the wave.
cards.rationale: A crashed wave can create a short farming window; actual camp availability remains unknown.

sources.excerpt: Push first, then camp, return as waves clash
Don't be farming when your team is grouping for Midboss/Rift/Urn/push

cards.speech: Your wave is pushed. Shop now and be back for the next wave.
cards.rationale: Use a wave window to convert unspent currency into usable power.

sources.excerpt: Crash wave then shop, then return

cards.speech: Objective soon. Clear your wave, then we rotate.
cards.rationale: Prepare lane priority before leaving for a scheduled objective.

sources.excerpt: Clear your wave first, then go to the objective

cards.speech: Your wave is pushed. Group for the objective; skip the extra camp.
cards.rationale: Use lane priority to prepare an objective rotation rather than delaying for extra farm.

sources.excerpt: Don't be farming when your team is grouping for Midboss/Rift/Urn/push
